span.p:
Check detection coverage / quality
(DEH V2, Part 41-42)
for the org's actual threat profile

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Validated detection
exists for the threats
that matter most?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Priority: fund detection engineering.
Org-design and playbook maturity
can't compensate for a threat
the SOC never sees fire.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Check playbook-quality maturity
(SOC Playbook Handbook,
Appendix 38A)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Playbooks for those
detected threats are
structurally mature?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Priority: fund playbook
development and review.
Detection works; response
guidance doesn't yet.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Staffing, process, training,
and tooling mature enough
to execute reliably at volume?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Priority: fund staffing,
process, training, or tooling
(Table 30.1) -- detection and
playbooks are ready; the
organization running them isn't.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
All three lenses read strong:
the only combination that
supports calling the SOC
broadly mature.
